reviewedScope: First-party existence pages, current homepage/footer, linked privacy/conditions and bounded same-host search. No explicit information-use, acquisition or database prohibition found in this technical review.
reuseLimits: Normalized factual existence/address/qualifiers only; no HTML, prose, images, floor plans, maps or logos redistributed.
A source-specific approval is still required independently from coordinate/parcel terms approval.
A publisher objection or applicable explicit information-use restriction requires hold/re-review.
context: Saint-Marc privacy policy covers personal data/SNS; restrictions on SNS copying are not treated as a licence or an information/database prohibition on this fact sheet.
rightsReading: 公式ナビ・footerの権利関連リンクはprivacy。privacy内の個人情報・SNS利用規約の範囲を確認し、SNSで公式WEBサイトを模写して投稿する禁止を、正規化した最小限の店舗事実の情報利用禁止と読み替えない。確認範囲で情報利用・取得・DB化の明示禁止は発見せず。オープンライセンスでも個別許諾でもない。
